propositions: Blocking link edges written before comparability became structural remain stale on disk because LINK events are durable and never re-resolved on read, causing them to distort ready/next-batch and parent-first cascades.

The store-wide scan must detect three finding kinds (ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, unreadable) by asking the current resolver what each edge should be, reusing the reducer's compiled deps[] rather than replaying LINK/UNLINK.

Repair writes the replacement link before removing the stale one so an interruption leaves a superset for the next run to converge, and declines pairs whose unlink would cancel a different relation (ambiguous-pair).
Read-only doctor runs must not trigger store reconverge by calling ensure_initialized with init_only=True, while --repair runs converge with init_only=False.

The --repair command must refuse to run while a reconciler pass is in flight, force-write pre-doctor-repair tag at pre-run OID as rollback anchor, and acquire the write lock per-event rather than holding it across the loop to avoid self-deadlock.
